---
title: "Dr. Punam Amratia"
---

**Senior Research Scientist; Technical Lead, MAP Dar es Salaam Node, Ifakara Health Institute**

With over a decade of experience in malaria epidemiology, biostatistics,
and geospatial modelling, Dr. Amratia has made significant contributions
to understanding and mapping malaria risk and burden. She also teaches
data science courses at the University of Oxford and has supported
capacity strengthening in numerous malaria-endemic countries.

She holds an MSc in Epidemiology from Imperial College London and a PhD
in Emerging Pathogens from the University of Florida.
